name: Destructive Squall
description: A violent storm erupts from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in the Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 5d6 Thunder damage and 5d6 Cold damage and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.
summary: A violent storm erupts from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in the Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw against Thunder and Cold damage.
notes: Dark Sun homebrew spell. Rework of Destructive Wave for the Rain patron domain.
